paper_metadata.title: Focus review on γ′ coarsening in theorical development and application in Ni-base superalloys and high/medium-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Long-term thermal exposure-induced γ′ coarsening strongly influences the mechanical properties of Ni-base superalloys and high/medium entropy alloys (H/MEAs), which has long been of scientific and industrial concern.

Long-term thermal exposure-induced γ′ coarsening strongly influences the mechanical properties of Ni-base superalloys and high/medium entropy alloys (H/MEAs), which has long been of scientific and industrial concern.
Over the past decades, this issue has received extensive attention in Ni-base superalloys, particularly with the binary Ni–Al system as a typical prototype [12–14].
Much compelling evidence for the anomalous efficacy of fv on K(fv) has been found, particularly in Ni-Al [46,63] and Ni–Si alloys [64,65].
Amongst, a class of 3d transition metal H/MEAs [3,4], like NiCoCr-systems, are regarded as the extensions of Ni-base superalloys in terms of compositional designs.
